question: What is the meaning of eu ecolabel in relation to compliance and certification?
description: The EU Ecolabel is a voluntary label awarded to products that meet high environmental standards throughout their life cycle. It signifies compliance with these standards and serves as a certification for products that contribute to a circular economy and reduce environmental impact. The Ecolabel is part of the broader EU green public procurement criteria and aims to promote sustainable products in the market.

references.text:
Implementing measures adopted under Directive 2009/125/EC have also included requirements 
concerning circularity aspects, such as durability, repairability and recyclability. At the same time, instruments such 
as the EU Ecolabel, introduced by Regulation (EC) No 66/2010 of the European Parliament and of the Council (12), or 
the EU green public procurement criteria set out in the communication of the Commission of 16 July 2008 on 
Public procurement for a better environment are broader in scope but have a reduced impact due to the limitations 
of voluntary approaches.
